# TL4 Magazine features an article by Matthew Toma on collection risk


- Asset recovery


March 6, 2025


-
-
-
-


*TL4 Magazine* features Burford's[Matthew Toma](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/matthew-toma/) in an article on how to manage and finance collection risk beyond the courtroom.


In the piece, Toma discusses how legal finance can help claimants to assess and mitigate collection risk.


[Read the article in full here.](https://thoughtleaders4.com/disputes/disputes-knowledge-hub-view/disputes-magazine-issue-16-navigating-the-path-to-peaceful-resolution)
